def count_rotation(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    # Count the number of positions where arr[i] < arr[i-1]
    # This equals the number of rotations needed to sort the array
    rotations = sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if arr[i] < arr[i - 1])

    # If the array wraps around (i.e., arr[0] < arr[n-1]), add one more
    if arr[-1] < arr[0]:
        rotations += 1

    return rotations

assert count_rotation([3, 2, 1]) == 1
